Do not add spoken or sung lines.

claims.text: A locked camera observes rain running down a bus window at night; exactly two shots are required.
Specific droplets tremble, merge, and drag crooked trails through condensation, leaving clear channels that sharpen the blurred city lights.
The bus interior is dark and reflected faintly on the glass, with soft rain and a low muffled engine hum.
Blurred amber streetlamps, a red tail light, and a pale green glow appear beyond the rain-streaked pane.

description.text: A night bus window fills the frame from inside the darkened vehicle. Cold raindrops bead across the glass in irregular clusters, some clinging in place and trembling while others break loose and drag short crooked trails through the condensation. Beyond the pane the city is a soft wash of out-of-focus light: amber streetlamps, a red smudge of a tail light, and a pale green glow, all smeared and wavering as the water bends and scatters it. The dark bus interior reflects faintly on the inner surface, a dim ghost of the cabin overlapping the moving lights. Nothing inside the bus is disturbed; only the rain travels.
Rain beads and condensation cover the dark bus window, with blurred amber, red, and pale green city lights beyond.
Soft, irregular rain taps against the glass over a low muffled bus hum.
Several droplets tremble, break loose, and drag short crooked trails through the condensation.

The shot cuts to a tighter view of the same rain-streaked bus window, the night city still blurred to colored haze beyond the glass. A single large droplet sits heavy near the center of the pane, quivering, then draws a smaller neighbor into itself and swells. Released, it runs a wavering vertical line down the condensation, gathering other beads as it goes and leaving a clear, sharply defined channel that momentarily sharpens the smear of amber and red light behind it. Smaller droplets continue to tremble and slide around it, while the dark cabin remains a faint reflection on the glass. Only the water moves within the frame.
A single large droplet sits near the center of the same rain-streaked pane, surrounded by smaller beads and condensation.
The large droplet quivers, draws in a smaller neighbor, swells, then runs downward in a wavering line.
A faint squeak accompanies the drop dragging across the glass, under the continuing rain and engine hum.
The running drop leaves a clear channel that sharpens the amber and red lights behind the window.

json.soundscape: Rain patters softly against the glass with a low muffled bus-engine hum and faint road hiss.
